Record Class TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame
Record Components:
game - the game snapshot to draw
vm - shared read model (player-name lookups)
myTotem - the local player's totem, may be null
highlights - card moves to render as selected
offerCursorIndex - offer-track tile to mark, or -1 for none
cardCursor - the picking cursor, or null when not picking
rowFocus - the passive row marker, or null when picking
topRowOffset - horizontal scroll offset of the top card row
lowRowOffset - horizontal scroll offset of the bottom card row
Enclosing class:
TuiBoardRenderer
public static record TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame(GameDTO game, GameViewModel vm, Totem myTotem, Set<Move> highlights, int offerCursorIndex, TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame.CardCursor cardCursor, TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame.RowFocus rowFocus, int topRowOffset, int lowRowOffset) extends Record
Immutable per-frame description of everything the board renderer needs. The screen rebuilds one of these each render pass; the renderer only reads.
